subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live in scoped browser UiSettings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or be declined in favor of the current Enter-to-send behavior?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested preference, but adding any persisted shortcut setting creates product and compatibility surface that repository policy treats as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Add a gateway-scoped Control UI preference, keep Enter-to-send as the default, route visible copy through i18n, and test Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Introduce a documented gateway/openclaw.json setting only if maintainers want operators to control the shortcut across browser clients.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Decline the preference and keep plain Enter as the only primary send shortcut, leaving duplicates closed by product decision.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Add a gateway-scoped Control UI preference, keep Enter-to-send as the default, route visible copy through i18n, and test Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review comments and recent current-main ownership across the relevant WebChat/settings/docs surface make this the clearest available owner for the settings-scope choice.
